channel.title: Self-Hosting on ProHomeLab – everything about homelab and self-hosting
channel.description: Recent content in Self-Hosting on ProHomeLab – everything about homelab and self-hosting

item.title: Docker Hit Its Network Limit: How I Diagnosed and Fixed It with default-address-pools
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: Breaking down a real case: after moving to a dedicated Docker network per compose stack, I hit the could not find an available, non-overlapping IPv4 address pool limit. Why this happens, how to diagnose it, and how to fix it for good via default-address-pools in daemon.json.

item.title: Arcane: A Modern Docker Manager — Overview, Installation, and Configuration
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: An overview of Arcane - a young but fast-growing web interface for Docker - and a step-by-step guide to installation, configuring secrets, connecting existing compose projects, and basic socket protection.

item.title: Dozzle: A Convenient Real-Time Log Viewer for Docker Containers
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A step-by-step overview of Dozzle - a lightweight self-hosted tool for viewing Docker container logs in real time through a web interface. Installation via Docker Compose, setting up authentication, multi-host mode via agents, and recommendations for docker.sock security.

item.title: Connecting Applications to a Shared PostgreSQL and Learning Basic Maintenance: Part 2
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: The second part of the series on a shared PostgreSQL for a home server. We create a dedicated, minimally privileged user and database in pgAdmin for a specific application, connect Authentik to the shared database instead of its own container, and cover basic maintenance - VACUUM, ANALYZE, REINDEX, and when you actually need to do any of this by hand.

item.title: Postiz: Trying to Automate YouTube, VK, and RuTube, and Why Only One Out of Three Actually Works
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: I set up self-hosted Postiz and try to connect it to YouTube, VK, and RuTube - walking through the real steps, the required env variables, and known bugs. In the end, out of three platforms, only one works reliably, and I honestly explain why.

item.title: Moving from Portainer to Komodo: Full Installation and Setup
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A step-by-step guide to installing Komodo as a Portainer alternative: docker-compose, MongoDB, bind mounts instead of volumes, login via Authentik (OIDC), and connecting additional hosts via Periphery.

item.title: Installing Traefik in an LXC Container on Proxmox as a Systemd Service: Part 3: CrowdSec
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: Part three of the Traefik-in-LXC series - installing CrowdSec in the same container as Traefik itself. Scenario collections, a remediation profile with Gotify notifications, log sources (Traefik, syslog, AppSec), and wiring the bouncer plugin back into Traefik.

item.title: Installing Traefik in an LXC Container on Proxmox as a Systemd Service: Part 2
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: Continuing the series about Traefik in LXC - from a test binary to a working configuration. Cloudflare token, final static config, wildcard certificate, dashboard protection via Basic Auth, log rotation, dynamic config structure, and migrating a dozen services from Docker labels to the file provider. CrowdSec is planned as a separate follow-up.

item.title: Middlewares in Traefik: What They Are, Why You Need Them, and the Full List for a Homelab
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: Middleware is the second most important building block of Traefik after routers. In this article I break down what it is, why it’s needed, how it’s applied, what a chain is, and I go through all the middlewares from the open-source version of Traefik with the configuration examples I use myself.

item.title: Installing Traefik in a Proxmox LXC Container as a Systemd Service: Part 1
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed guide to installing and configuring Traefik in an LXC container to set up a reverse proxy. Covers Docker setup, routing configuration, SSL integration, and recommendations for managing web traffic.

item.title: Obsidian Plugins I Use
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A rundown of 36 Obsidian plugins that replaced Trilium Notes’ built-in functionality after the move - from Templater and Bases to Excalidraw and Kanban. I compare the philosophy of the two systems and explain why the deciding factor was YAML Front Matter support for publishing articles via Hugo.

item.title: Automatic ZFS Snapshots on Fedora Server 44 Using Sanoid
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: Continuing the series of articles about a home NAS on Fedora Server 44. This time we set up automatic creation and cleanup of ZFS snapshots using Sanoid, go over the snapshot retention policy and systemd timers, and get acquainted with Syncoid for future data replication to a backup server.

item.title: Setting Up a Home NAS on Fedora Server 44 with OpenZFS, Cockpit, and Samba
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: We build a modern home NAS on Fedora Server 44 with the OpenZFS filesystem, the Cockpit web interface, and the Samba file server. A complete step-by-step guide to installation, ZFS configuration, SELinux, and publishing an SMB share.

item.title: Dockhand: A Web UI for Docker with Traefik Integration
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A complete guide to installing and configuring Dockhand - a simple and convenient web UI for managing Docker containers in homelab and production environments.

item.title: NetBird: Publishing Services without a Public IP or Port Forwarding
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: Netbird lets you publish local services to the internet without opening ports, using secure tunnels and a convenient web interface - an ideal solution for a home server and homelab.

item.title: Pangolin: An Easy Way to Expose Access to Your Homelab
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: Pangolin lets you publish local services to the internet without opening ports, using secure tunnels and a convenient web interface — an ideal solution for a home server and homelab.

item.title: Zerobyte: Backup Automation for Self-Hosted Infrastructure
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A step-by-step guide to installing and configuring Zerobyte for backup automation in self-hosted infrastructure and homelabs.

item.title: Duplicati: Encrypted Backups for Your Home Server
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A step-by-step guide to installing and configuring Duplicati for automatic encrypted backups on a home server or in the cloud

item.title: Grimmory: A Self-Hosted Library and Reader for Your Book Collection
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed walkthrough for installing and configuring Grimmory: deploying it in Docker, adding books, organizing your library, and using the built-in web reader.

item.title: BookLore: A Self-Hosted Library and Reader for Your Book Collection
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed guide to installing and configuring BookLore: deploying it in Docker, adding books, organizing your library, and using the built-in web reader.

item.title: ZimaBoard 2: A Mini-Server Review for the Homelab
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A look at the ZimaBoard 2: specs, use cases, performance, and homelab applications - from Docker to virtualization.

item.title: Memos: Setting Up Self-Hosted Notes for Quick Thoughts
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: We go through installing and configuring Memos - a minimalist self-hosted app for quick notes and a personal journal. I’ll show how to run it in Docker, its core features, how to organize notes, and homelab use cases.

item.title: Authentik: Setting Up a Reputation Policy
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A step-by-step setup of the Reputation Policy and GeoIP in Authentik for restricting access by IP reputation and country, with a breakdown of typical protection scenarios.

item.title: Setting Up Email Notifications in Authentik
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A step-by-step guide to setting up email notifications in Authentik: connecting SMTP, enabling event notifications, configuring email templates, and verifying delivery.

item.title: Cloudflare Turnstile in Authentik: Setting Up Login Form Protection
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed guide to setting up Cloudflare Turnstile - a modern alternative to CAPTCHA for protecting login, registration, and password recovery forms without degrading the user experience.

item.title: Setting Up Two-Factor Authentication in Authentik
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A guide to setting up two-factor authentication in Authentik using TOTP and WebAuthn, covering flows, stages, and security best practices.

item.title: Setting Up User Enrollment and Invitation Processes in Authentik
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A guide to setting up the enrollment and invitation flow in Authentik: registering new users, invitations, stages, flows, and access policies.

item.title: Setting Up Password Recovery in Authentik
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed guide to setting up password recovery in Authentik, covering flows, stages, and policies, along with recommendations for protecting against username enumeration attacks.

item.title: Podman: A Modern Alternative to Docker
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: Podman is a daemonless container engine focused on security and rootless operation. A look at the project’s history, architecture, differences from Docker, pods, Quadlet, and Podlet - and when it’s worth switching.

item.title: The Best Self-Hosted Apps of 2025: A Personal Roundup
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: In this article we’ve rounded up the most interesting self-hosted apps that appeared in 2025. From media servers and productivity tools to security and automation systems — let’s look at what’s worth trying and why.

item.title: Docker vs Podman vs Kubernetes: A Detailed Comparison of Container Technologies
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: Comparing Docker, Podman, and Kubernetes: architecture, security, overhead, and real-world use cases - from homelab to production clusters.

item.title: Quadlet and Podlet in Podman: How to Stop Writing Long podman run Commands and Run Containers under systemd
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: Quadlet is Podman’s declarative systemd unit format, and Podlet is a utility that generates those units from podman run and docker-compose.yml. A hands-on look at both tools, compared against Docker Compose.

item.title: What Is Homelabbing and Why It's Worth Doing
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: Homelabbing is building a home lab for experimenting with servers, networks, and services. It helps you learn technologies, test new solutions, and develop practical IT skills.

item.title: How to Upgrade Linux Server Distributions
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed guide to safely upgrading Debian, Ubuntu Server, and Fedora Server distributions, with command examples

item.title: Authentik: Initial Setup After Installation
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed overview of the initial setup of Authentik - an open source system for centralized authentication and authorization (IdP/SSO). We’ll walk through the very first steps of setting up Authentik.

item.title: OIDC, OAuth2, and Proxy Provider in Authentik: How to Protect Any Application
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed explanation of how Authentik’s Proxy Provider adds authentication and SSO to any application. A simple flow diagram, key concepts, and usage examples.

item.title: Diun: Notifications About Docker Image Updates
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed guide to installing and configuring Diun for tracking Docker image updates. Covers deployment steps, integration with notification services, and monitoring automation, so you can update your containers on time and improve system security.

item.title: Obsidian vs TriliumNext: A Comparison of Knowledge Management Systems
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed comparison of Obsidian and TriliumNext: two powerful systems for organizing notes and a personal knowledge base. Which one should you choose for your workflow?

item.title: Trilium: Installing and Setting Up a Note-Taking System
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A step-by-step guide to installing and configuring Trilium for organizing notes and knowledge bases on a personal server. Covers installation via Docker, web interface setup, users, and recommendations for effective note management.

item.title: Vaultwarden: Server Installation, an Alternative to Bitwarden
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A step-by-step guide to installing Vaultwarden - a lightweight self-hosted version of Bitwarden. From a basic docker-compose to an advanced configuration with SSO and push notifications.

item.title: Mealie: Self-Hosted App for Recipes, Meal Planning, and Shopping Lists
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A step-by-step guide to installing and configuring Mealie for managing recipes on your own server. Covers installation via Docker, database setup, the web interface and mobile access, integration with external recipe sources, plus the new AI features (importing recipes from video) and unit standardization.

item.title: Setting Up PostgreSQL and pgAdmin in Docker with Docker Compose for Beginners: Part 1
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed guide to installing and configuring PostgreSQL on a server. Covers installation steps, creating users and databases, setting up backups, and basic security for stable and reliable operation.

item.title: Authelia vs Authentik vs Keycloak vs ZITADEL: Which One to Choose?
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A comparative overview of popular authentication solutions: Authelia, Authentik, Keycloak, and Zitadel. Covers the capabilities, pros and cons of each service, use-case scenarios, and recommendations for choosing the right tool for home or corporate use.

item.title: Audiobookshelf: The Best Self-Hosted Audiobook Server
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A complete guide to installing and configuring Audiobookshelf for storing and listening to audiobooks on your own server. All steps are covered, from installation to the web interface and mobile access.

item.title: Linkwarden Overview: A Modern Self-Hosted Bookmark Manager
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A step-by-step guide to installing and configuring Linkwarden for securely managing your links. Covers server installation, user setup, browser and mobile device integration, and basic security settings.

item.title: Pros and Cons of Fedora Server 42
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed guide to installing and configuring Fedora Server 42. Covers the main steps: installing the system, configuring users, network services, and a baseline configuration for a secure and stable server.
